description: Tenant-bound store role of the per-tenant approval store partitions (libs/core/governance/approval-store-location.ts). The approval store assumes it (withExecutionContext) for every tenant partition read and write, always bound to the record's tenant, so the grants resolve through ${KYBERION_TENANT} to that one tenant's active/shared/runtime/tenant-approvals/<personal|confidential>/<tenant>/ partition (public tenant records are stored in the confidential partition): it reads, writes and lists request records, reads and writes passkey challenges and appends the channel's approval event log. Tenant-bound (TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES): a caller with another active tenant cannot bind it, so a process bound to one tenant never finds another tenant's approvals. No knowledge, mission, system approval tree or customer/ grant.
